intent: Abstract interface a SQLiteNode uses to call back into whatever server embeds it: login notifications, state-change notifications to plugins, and command-port blocking.

objects.name: SQLiteServer
objects.role: pure-virtual interface (onNodeLogin, notifyStateChangeToPlugins, blockCommandPort, unblockCommandPort), extends STCPManager

location_fit.note: the callback contract for SQLiteNode's host server belongs here.
